scope.question: How does a player learn recovery during a pursuit without copying the source level?

estimate_basis: one implied retry before the visible fork
continuous landmark state across the visible run
time_model.campaign_position: mid_sequence, inferred from the checkpoint and pursuit escalation
unknown_intervals: Any traversal and retries removed before 04:06
The continuation after the cut at approximately 06:58

experience_time.range_basis: relative estimate from visible progression and omitted setup

editorial_status.notes: The first visible beat begins after an edit; the prior setup is unavailable.

event.player_action: Stops at a bell, rotates twice, then chooses the lit stair after the red pennant enters frame.
event.camera_or_edit: Camera sweep exposes a landmark but not the whole route.
event.world_feedback: Bell continues; no clear enemy body is visible.
event.player_knowledge_before: The player has a warning cue but uncertain direction.
event.player_knowledge_after: The lit stair is treated as the current route anchor.

emotion.inference: The pause suggests uncertainty more strongly than panic.
emotion.alternative_explanation: The player may be checking controls or waiting for audio information.

design_forecast.setup_before: Let a directional cue arrive before the player can see the threat.
design_forecast.expected_player_question: Which visible landmark is safe to trust?
design_forecast.payoff_or_reversal: The landmark supports a route choice without revealing the full map.
design_forecast.after_effect: Preserve the landmark so a later wrong turn can be recovered.
design_forecast.test_for_new_work: Ask a first-time tester to point to the recovery landmark before moving.

editorial_status.notes: No visible cut between B01 and B02.

event.player_action: Tests the closed gate once, then runs toward the stair.
event.camera_or_edit: Backward look is brief and does not show the pursuer.
event.world_feedback: Gate closure and footsteps increase pressure.
event.player_knowledge_before: Return is still possible in principle.
event.player_knowledge_after: Forward movement is the practical option.

emotion.inference: The closure converts uncertainty into time pressure.
emotion.alternative_explanation: The player may already know the route from an omitted attempt.

design_forecast.setup_before: Make the commitment visible and reversible only once.
design_forecast.expected_player_question: Did the threat force this route, or is there another exit?
design_forecast.payoff_or_reversal: The player receives a readable forward route rather than a blind maze.
design_forecast.after_effect: The next wrong turn should cost time, not erase all agency.
design_forecast.test_for_new_work: Measure whether testers can describe what changed when the door closed.

experience_time.range_basis: continuous visible action with a short return

editorial_status.notes: The player reaches the fork after visible traversal; exact movement time is approximate.

event.player_action: Takes the dry passage, reaches a dead end, laughs, reverses, and returns to the pennant.
event.camera_or_edit: The dead end is shown long enough to establish the error.
event.world_feedback: No new exit appears; the landmark remains readable on return.
event.player_knowledge_before: The fork has at least two plausible branches.
event.player_knowledge_after: One branch is rejected and the landmark restores orientation.

emotion.inference: The bounded error releases some pressure because recovery is immediate.
emotion.alternative_explanation: The laugh may be a creator persona habit rather than relief.

design_forecast.setup_before: Offer two credible choices under time pressure.
design_forecast.expected_player_question: Can I recover if this branch is wrong?
design_forecast.intended_emotional_transition: urgency to brief relief and learning
design_forecast.payoff_or_reversal: The wrong branch teaches the landmark rather than punishing with a full reset.
design_forecast.after_effect: Confidence should rise without making the next route trivial.
design_forecast.test_for_new_work: Compare completion and remembered landmark after one bounded wrong turn.

do_not_claim: B01 is the first pursuit cue
the player had no prior knowledge

limits: This is an edited highlight, not a real-time run.
The pursuiter's awareness state is not visible enough to claim patrol or search behavior.
The experience-time range is a design-analysis estimate, not recovered save data.
next_capture: A clean unedited run around the fork
One frame of the upper landing and one frame of the checkpoint transition
Any available chapter or retry context
